ref_sources: Street check along J.E. Irausquin from Druif to Eagle Beach: blue-roofed bus shelters on the inland sidewalk, lamp posts on the verge, white zebra bars at the public beach accesses, stall lines on the parking lots the kits already pave, and an open shower plus a lifeguard chair on the dry sand. The road shader already paints junction zebras, edge lines and a dashed centre. Fofoti stay on the existing heroes. Tulip is a freestanding board because that restaurant has no hero of its own. Geometry and the sign textures are original.
